event: Bidder Sub (Andromeda Australia SubCo Pty Limited) is incorporated to hold the Domain shares
source: Domain scheme booklet
evidence: Booklet p. 50 states Bidder Sub was incorporated on 10 February 2025 (opened 5 October 2026, local PDF).

event: Last undisturbed trading date; Domain closes at A$3.12
source: Domain scheme booklet
evidence: Booklet p. 42 gives the closing share price on the Last Undisturbed Trading Date of 20 February 2025 and A$3.12 appears on p. 42 (opened 5 October 2026).

event: CoStar buys 16.9% of Domain at A$4.20 a share, including an after-market crossing of 106,592,031 shares
source: Domain ASX announcement: Domain receives Unsolicited, Non-Binding Indicative Proposal from CoStar Group, Inc.
location: paragraph 3 (PDF p. 1); the crossing is in booklet p. 157 footnote 54
evidence: The announcement says CoStar acquired 16.9% on 20 February 2025 at A$4.20; booklet p. 157 footnote 54 gives the crossing of 106,592,031 shares at A$4.20 (opened 5 October 2026).
note: Booklet p. 54 says CoStar acquired 16.96% on 20 and 21 February 2025. The crossing of 106,592,031 shares is smaller than the 107,129,031 shares CoStar held (booklet p. 43); no document I opened explains the gap.

event: Domain announces an unsolicited, non-binding proposal at A$4.20 cash; the board has commenced an assessment, advisers will be appointed and shareholders need not act
source: Domain ASX announcement: Domain receives Unsolicited, Non-Binding Indicative Proposal from CoStar Group, Inc.
evidence: The announcement is dated Sydney, 21 February 2025 and states the A$4.20 proposal, the board's assessment, the adviser appointment and that shareholders need not act (opened 5 October 2026).
note: The announcement gives CoStar's ticker as CSGO; the later announcements use CSGP.

event: Nine says Domain is of strategic importance and that it will consider the proposal
source: Capital Brief article: Nine 'will consider' CoStar's move to acquire Domain
evidence: The article (published 2025-02-20T21:58Z, which is 21 February in Sydney) quotes Nine: "Domain is of strategic importance to Nine's media ecosystem and our long-term growth strategy" and "Nine will consider the proposal" (opened 5 October 2026).
note: Secondary source. I did not open Nine's own ASX release.

event: Substantial holder notice lodged showing CoStar's 16.96% interest
source: Domain scheme booklet
evidence: Booklet p. 54 states the 16.96% interest is disclosed in the substantial holder notice lodged with ASX on 24 February 2025 (opened 5 October 2026).
note: I did not find or open the notice itself.

event: Domain says it has received no revised proposal since 21 February and that the scheme needs Nine's support; Nine confirms it is in discussions with CoStar and engaged with Domain
source: Domain ASX announcement: Media reporting on CoStar Proposal (attaches Nine's release)
evidence: Both releases are dated 21 March 2025 and state those points (opened 5 October 2026).

event: CoStar improves its proposal to A$4.43, best and final in the absence of a competing proposal, a 5.5% uplift and a 42.0% premium to the 20 February close; the board unanimously decides to engage and allow due diligence
source: Domain ASX announcement: Improved non-binding indicative proposal from CoStar (copy on a third-party site)
evidence: The PDF is headed Sydney, 27 March 2025 and states the A$4.43 price, best and final basis, 42.0% premium, 5.5% uplift and the board's decision (opened 5 October 2026).
note: I could not find the ASX original, so the document is a mirror. Booklet p. 103 also dates the revised proposal 27 March 2025.

event: Domain signs an exclusivity and process deed; CoStar gets data room access; the directors confirm their intention to recommend if a deed is signed
source: Domain ASX announcement: Domain grants CoStar exclusive due diligence access and confirms intention to recommend
evidence: The announcement is dated Sydney, 31 March 2025 and states the deed, the data room access today, the recommendation intention and an exclusivity period of four weeks extendable by two (opened 5 October 2026).

event: Domain extends CoStar's exclusivity by two weeks
source: Domain ASX announcement: CoStar exclusivity period extended
location: index page title and release time
evidence: The announcement itself was not opened: Domain's file host returned HTTP 503 on 5 October 2026. The Market Index page opened and shows the title and a release time of 08:47 on 28 April 2025. Booklet p. 103 states the exclusivity was extended by a further two weeks through to 12 May 2025.
note: I could not open the announcement: Domain's file host returned an error.

event: Domain signs the Scheme Implementation Deed at A$4.43 less any special dividend; the board unanimously recommends it; Nine intends to vote in favour; the conditions include FIRB approval, the expert's conclusion and no material adverse change
source: Domain ASX announcement: Domain enters into Scheme Implementation Deed with CoStar
evidence: The announcement is dated Sydney, 9 May 2025 and states those points; the deed's clause 3.1 lists the conditions (opened 5 October 2026).
note: The announcement allows a special dividend of up to A$0.10 a share; the booklet (p. 103) says up to 8.8 cents, which is what was paid.

event: CoStar reports the deed to the SEC at A$4.43 a share
source: CoStar press release filed with Form 8-K
evidence: The fetched page is dated May 9, 2025 and states cash consideration of A$4.43 a share (opened 5 October 2026, read through a page-fetch tool because direct download returned HTTP 403).
note: Secondary to the ASX announcement for dates.

event: First Court Hearing at 3:00pm; the Court orders Domain to convene the scheme meeting
source: Domain scheme booklet key dates, and the ASX cover announcement 'Scheme Booklet registered with ASIC'
location: booklet p. 11; ASX cover announcement p. 1
evidence: Booklet p. 11 lists the First Court Hearing at 3:00pm on 30 June 2025, and the ASX cover announcement refers to the Court's order that Domain convene the meeting (opened 5 October 2026).
note: The separate ASX announcement of the court order was not opened.

event: The booklet is registered with ASIC and dated 30 June 2025; the board unanimously recommends a vote in favour in the absence of a superior proposal
source: Domain ASX announcement: Scheme Booklet registered with ASIC, and the booklet
location: ASX cover announcement pp. 1 to 2; booklet p. 5
evidence: The cover announcement states the booklet was registered with ASIC that day and that the board continues to recommend; booklet p. 5 says it is dated 30 June 2025 (opened 5 October 2026).

event: The independent expert, Grant Samuel, concludes the scheme is fair and reasonable and in shareholders' best interests, valuing the equity at A$2,580 to 2,830 million, or A$4.06 to A$4.46 a share; A$4.43 is near the top
source: Independent expert's report, in the Domain scheme booklet
evidence: Booklet p. 92 states the conclusion and range; p. 157 says A$4.43 is very close to the top end of the range (opened 5 October 2026).

event: Nine, holding 60.05%, confirms it will vote in favour in the absence of a superior proposal (as Nine decides) and subject to the expert's conclusion continuing
source: Domain ASX announcement: Scheme Booklet registered with ASIC, and the booklet
location: ASX cover announcement p. 2; booklet p. 9 and p. 91 footnote 2
evidence: The cover announcement and booklet p. 9 state Nine's voting intention and 60.05% holding (opened 5 October 2026).
note: Booklet p. 160 gives Nine's holding as 60.06%.

event: The booklet is expected to be dispatched to shareholders by this date (planned date)
source: Domain ASX announcement: Scheme Booklet registered with ASIC
evidence: The announcement says the booklet is expected to be dispatched by Friday, 4 July 2025 (opened 5 October 2026).
note: This is the planned date. I did not find a document recording the actual dispatch.

event: FIRB gives written notice that the Commonwealth has no objections, subject to conditions acceptable to CoStar; the FIRB condition is satisfied
source: Domain ASX announcement: FIRB approval received
evidence: The announcement is dated Sydney, 24 July 2025 and states the FIRB notice and that the condition at clause 3.1(a) is satisfied (opened 5 October 2026).

event: The ATO provides a draft class ruling consistent with the booklet's tax positions; the final ruling is not expected until after implementation
source: Domain ASX announcement: Update on ATO class ruling
evidence: The announcement is dated Sydney, 29 July 2025 and states those points (opened 5 October 2026).

event: The scheme meeting passes the resolution: 99.98% of votes cast in favour and 91.22% of holders present and voting in favour
source: Domain ASX announcement: Scheme Meeting results
evidence: The announcement is dated Sydney, 4 August 2025 and states both percentages (opened 5 October 2026).
note: The same announcement says implementation was expected on 20 August 2025; that is the Scheme Record Date, and implementation was on 27 August 2025.

event: Domain's directors determine a fully franked special dividend of 8.8 cents a share
source: ATO Class Ruling CR 2025/86
evidence: Paragraph 48 states that on 4 August 2025 the directors determined a Permitted Special Dividend of A$0.088 and paragraph 49 states it was fully franked (opened 5 October 2026).
note: I did not find Domain's own determination notice.

event: The Supreme Court of NSW (Black J) approves the scheme
source: Court orders attached to the Domain ASX announcement: Scheme of arrangement becomes legally effective and suspension of trading on ASX
evidence: The order is dated 6 August 2025, records Black J and approves the scheme under section 411(4)(b); ATO CR 2025/86 paragraph 44 gives the same date (opened 5 October 2026).
note: The separate same-day ASX announcement of the approval was not opened.

event: Effective Date: the court orders are lodged with ASIC and trading is suspended from the close
source: Domain ASX announcement: Scheme of arrangement becomes legally effective and suspension of trading on ASX
evidence: The announcement is dated Sydney, 7 August 2025 and states the lodgement and the suspension at the close of trading that day (opened 5 October 2026).

event: Special dividend record date, 7:00pm AEST
source: Domain ASX announcement: Scheme of arrangement becomes legally effective and suspension of trading on ASX
evidence: The announcement gives the record date of 7:00pm (AEST) on Tuesday, 12 August 2025 (opened 5 October 2026).

event: The special dividend of 8.8 cents a share, fully franked, is paid
source: Domain ASX announcement: Implementation of scheme of arrangement
evidence: The announcement says the dividend was paid on Tuesday, 19 August 2025 (opened 5 October 2026).

event: Scheme Record Date, 7:00pm AEST
source: Domain ASX announcement: Implementation of scheme of arrangement
evidence: The announcement gives the Scheme Record Date as 7:00pm (AEST) on Wednesday, 20 August 2025 (opened 5 October 2026).

event: The scheme is implemented and A$4.342 cash a share is paid (A$4.43 less the 8.8 cent dividend); all Domain directors resign and three new directors are appointed
source: Domain ASX announcement: Implementation of scheme of arrangement
evidence: The announcement is dated Sydney, 27 August 2025 and states the implementation, the A$4.342 payment and the change of directors (opened 5 October 2026).

event: CoStar reports completion: it has acquired the remaining 83% or so of Domain at A$4.43 less the A$0.088 special dividend
source: CoStar Form 8-K, Item 7.01
evidence: The fetched filing gives August 27, 2025 as the completion date and states A$4.43 less A$0.088 (opened 5 October 2026, read through a page-fetch tool because direct download returned HTTP 403).
note: Secondary to the ASX announcement for dates.

event: Domain is removed from the Official List at the close of trading under Listing Rule 17.11
source: ASX Market Announcement: Domain Holdings Australia Limited (ASX: DHG) - Removal from Official List
evidence: The notice is dated 28 August 2025 and states the removal at the close of trading that day (opened 5 October 2026).

event: The ATO issues the final Class Ruling CR 2025/86 on the scheme and the special dividend
source: ATO Class Ruling CR 2025/86
evidence: Page 7 of 8 carries the Commissioner's date of 10 December 2025 and the ruling covers the scheme and special dividend (opened 5 October 2026).
note: Paragraph 37 gives 651,657,153 shares at 30 June 2025, while the booklet (p. 126) gives 631,657,153; the ruling looks like a typo and I have not confirmed it.
